Every text

Share it with family. They text photos, videos, voice memos, and stories, just like texting anyone. No app or account needed.

What's a Liine Memory?

Liine keeps everything

Every text is saved as a Liine Memory, with everything everyone said, ready to relive anytime.

A Liine Memory=Photo, video or voice memo+Everything the family said about it

Big days

Be there for the big days, even if you can't be.

Grandma can't be at prom. Her message can. Add #SEALED to any text, and it opens on the day you choose.

Tap a day to read a sealed letter.

How sealing works ›

Add #SEALED to a text and pick the day: a birthday, a first day, a wedding, or "a hard day". Everyone can see that a sealed memory exists, but not what it says. It opens for your child on that day. A sealed letter can even come with a physical gift, mailed so it arrives on the day.

When they're ready

The number becomes theirs. Every memory waiting.

Their first phone comes with their whole childhood, in everyone's words. When they're ready, the whole vault is theirs to keep.
